titleEn: Buying a train ticket to the coast
titleTh: ซื้อตั๋วรถไฟไปเที่ยวทะเล
scenarioSentences: You want to go to the coast.
You go to the ticket office.

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.text: Hello. I'd like a return ticket to the coast, please.

dialogue.speaker: Mr. Barnes
dialogue.text: Sure. When do you want to travel?

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.text: This Saturday. I want to come back on Sunday.

dialogue.speaker: Mr. Barnes
dialogue.text: Okay. On Saturday, there are trains at nine and eleven.

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.text: Nine is good. Can I take any train back?

dialogue.speaker: Mr. Barnes
dialogue.text: Yes, any train on Sunday. The ticket is twenty-four dollars.

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.text: Here you are. Which platform does the nine o'clock train leave from?

dialogue.speaker: Mr. Barnes
dialogue.text: Platform 3. Please be there ten minutes early.

titleEn: Ordering pizza for a movie night
titleTh: สั่งพิซซ่ามากินคืนดูหนัง
scenarioSentences: You are having a movie night.

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.text: Let's order pizza for tonight. What kind do you like?

dialogue.speaker: Nico
dialogue.text: I like cheese pizza. But Mia doesn't eat meat.

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.text: Okay. How about one cheese and one vegetable pizza?

dialogue.speaker: Nico
dialogue.text: Good idea. How many people are coming?

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.text: Seven, with us. Small pizzas or large ones?

dialogue.speaker: Nico
dialogue.text: Large ones. Seven people eat a lot!

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.text: Right, two large pizzas. That's twenty-four dollars.

dialogue.speaker: Nico
dialogue.text: Fine. I can pay half.

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.text: Thanks! I'll call the pizza shop now.

dialogue.speaker: Nico
dialogue.text: Great. Ask them to bring it at seven.

titleTh: เลือกสีทาห้องนอน
scenarioSentences: You want to paint your bedroom.
You go to a paint shop.

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.text: Lena, I can't choose a color. Can you help?

dialogue.speaker: Lena
dialogue.text: Sure. Do you like blue, green or yellow?

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.text: I like blue, but my room is small and dark.

dialogue.speaker: Lena
dialogue.text: Then choose a light color. Dark colors make a room look small.

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.text: What about this light yellow?

dialogue.speaker: Lena
dialogue.text: Your curtains are orange. Yellow and orange won't look nice.

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.text: True. How about light green, then?

dialogue.speaker: Lena
dialogue.text: Yes! Light green looks good with orange.

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.text: Okay, light green. I'll buy two cans.

dialogue.speaker: Lena
dialogue.text: Good. I can help you paint on Saturday.

titleEn: Renting a bike in the city
titleTh: เช่าจักรยานเที่ยวในเมือง
scenarioSentences: You want to see the city by bike.
You want to rent a bike.

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.text: Hi. I'd like to rent a bike, please. How much is it?

dialogue.speaker: Mr. Costa
dialogue.text: It's fifteen dollars a day, or twenty-five for two days.

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.text: Two days, please. That's a good price.

dialogue.speaker: Mr. Costa
dialogue.text: Good choice. Do you need a helmet too?

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.text: Yes, please. Is there an extra cost for the helmet?

dialogue.speaker: Mr. Costa
dialogue.text: No, the helmet is free. You just need to show your passport.

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.text: Here it is. When do I bring the bike back?

dialogue.speaker: Mr. Costa
dialogue.text: Please bring it back by six on Sunday evening.

titleTh: สอบถามเรื่องคลาสโยคะ
scenarioSentences: There is a class near your home.

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.text: Hello, Ms. Rao. I'd like to join your yoga class.

dialogue.speaker: Ms. Rao
dialogue.text: Great! Is this your first time?

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.text: Yes, it is. Is the class okay for beginners?

dialogue.speaker: Ms. Rao
dialogue.text: Yes. My Monday class at six is for beginners.

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.text: What do I need to wear?

dialogue.speaker: Ms. Rao
dialogue.text: Comfortable clothes, like a T-shirt and soft pants.

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.text: Do I need to bring a mat?

dialogue.speaker: Ms. Rao
dialogue.text: No, we have mats. But bring a bottle of water.

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.text: Okay. I'll come on Monday at six.

dialogue.speaker: Ms. Rao
dialogue.text: Lovely. Please come ten minutes early.

titleTh: ซื้อเสื้อแจ็กเก็ตกันหนาว
scenarioSentences: Your jacket is old and thin.

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.text: Excuse me. I need a warm jacket for the winter.

dialogue.speaker: Pedro
dialogue.text: Sure. These jackets are very warm. What size do you wear?

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.text: Medium, I think. Can I try this one?

dialogue.speaker: Pedro
dialogue.text: Of course. The fitting room is over there.

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.text: It fits well. Does it come in other colors?

dialogue.speaker: Pedro
dialogue.text: Yes, in gray, red and dark blue.

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.text: Dark blue, please. It goes with my jeans.

dialogue.speaker: Pedro
dialogue.text: Here you are. It's sixty-five dollars.

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.text: Okay, I'll take the dark blue jacket.

titleTh: ขอยืมเต็นท์เพื่อนไปตั้งแคมป์
scenarioSentences: You are going camping this weekend.
You do not have a tent.

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.text: Hi, Hugo. Can I borrow your tent this weekend?

dialogue.speaker: Hugo
dialogue.text: Sure. Where are you going?

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.text: To the lake with my cousin. We're leaving on Saturday morning.

dialogue.speaker: Hugo
dialogue.text: Okay. The tent is for two people. Is that okay?

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.text: Yes, that's perfect. When can I get it?

dialogue.speaker: Hugo
dialogue.text: Come to my house on Friday evening.

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.text: Great. I'll bring it back on Monday.

dialogue.speaker: Hugo
dialogue.text: That's fine. Please dry it before you bring it back.

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.text: No problem. I'll dry it in the sun on Sunday.

dialogue.speaker: Hugo
dialogue.text: Thanks. Have fun at the lake!

titleTh: ขึ้นรถเมล์ผิดสาย
scenarioSentences: You want to go to the library.

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.text: Excuse me. Does this bus go to the city library?

dialogue.speaker: Mr. Lee
dialogue.text: No, sorry. This bus goes the other way.

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.text: Oh no! What can I do?

dialogue.speaker: Mr. Lee
dialogue.text: Get off at the next stop. Then take bus 12.

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.text: Where is the bus 12 stop?

dialogue.speaker: Mr. Lee
dialogue.text: It's across the street, in front of the bank.

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.text: How long is the ride to the library?

dialogue.speaker: Mr. Lee
dialogue.text: About twenty minutes. Bus 12 comes every ten minutes.

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.text: Okay, I'll get off at the next stop. Thank you!

dialogue.speaker: Mr. Lee
dialogue.text: You're welcome. Here's the stop now.

titleEn: Planning a video call with family
titleTh: นัดวิดีโอคอลคุยกับครอบครัว
scenarioSentences: You want to plan a video call.

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.text: Hi, Noah. Let's have a video call with the family this weekend.

dialogue.speaker: Noah
dialogue.text: Good idea! But remember, when it's noon there, it's six here.

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.text: I know. Is Saturday at two, my time, okay?

dialogue.speaker: Noah
dialogue.text: That's eight in the evening here. Dad works late on Saturdays.

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.text: Then how about Sunday at the same time?

dialogue.speaker: Noah
dialogue.text: Sunday at eight is perfect. Everyone is home then.

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.text: Great. Can Grandma join us too?

dialogue.speaker: Noah
dialogue.text: Yes, she comes for dinner on Sundays.

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.text: Okay. So, Sunday at eight your time. I'll call you.

titleEn: Buying a ticket to a museum
titleTh: ซื้อบัตรเข้าชมพิพิธภัณฑ์
scenarioSentences: You are at the city museum.
You want to see the paintings.
Ms. Fox works at the desk.

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.text: Hello. Can I get a student ticket, please?

dialogue.speaker: Ms. Fox
dialogue.text: Sure. Can I see your student ID?

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.text: Here it is. How much is it?

dialogue.speaker: Ms. Fox
dialogue.text: It's eight dollars for students.

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.text: Great. Where are the old paintings?

dialogue.speaker: Ms. Fox
dialogue.text: Upstairs, on the second floor. Take the stairs on your left.

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.text: Thanks. What time does the museum close today?

dialogue.speaker: Ms. Fox
dialogue.text: At six o'clock, so you have about three hours.

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.text: Perfect. I'll go upstairs and look at the paintings first.
